findings.evidence: Grep confirms private induced_bot_of_injective and nhds_induced_bot at InitialTopology.lean:47,54; eventually_eq_of_continuous_bot and induced_bot_of_bijective at Spf/SectionsTopology.lean:414,861; and not_discreteTopology_pi_bot at Examples/AlgebraicGeometry/FormalScheme/Spf/SectionsTopology.lean:124. Their statements and proofs use only general Mathlib topology and algebra.
findings.fix: Relocate and export the general topology lemmas in a topology infrastructure module; use the injective version for both applications instead of maintaining a separate bijective version.
findings.issue: General topology results are hidden as private helpers, including two separate proofs that an injective map induces the discrete topology.

findings.evidence: The declaration at line 65 identifies the fibre of Ideal.Quotient.mk J over mk J x with x + J for arbitrary J; its proof uses only Ideal.Quotient.eq and additive identities.
findings.fix: Move it to the canonical ideal-quotient infrastructure and export it publicly.

summary: Several private lemmas are general infrastructure independent of formal spectra or adic completion, preventing reuse through the public API.
